Minimum Requirements:

  • Portuguese as a first language.
  • C1 or C2 Level English Speaker
  • University degree in English Teaching or related area.
  • One year of experience in teaching English as a foreign language.
  • Access to a computer with a reliable, high-speed (at least 2MB) internet connection.
  • Must pass a criminal background check.
  • Teachers must provide at least ten (10) hours of weekly availability.

Who we are:

Established in 2003, LatinHire recruits and manages teams of subject matter experts (SMEs) for online education companies. For over 20 years, our teams have played key roles in the backend of very successful educational startups.

title: Global Leadership Trainee (Mars Program)
description:
Work Location: Cities where Keeta operates, including São Paulo, UAE, Kuwait, KSA, Hong Kong, Beijing, etc. Willingness to accept global rotation is required.

You will have 2 to 4 Job rotations covering B-side, C-side, D-side and Business Analysis in the first two years. The specific job responsibilities depend on which position you will take. Generally, it may include:

1. Assist in formulating and executing the overall strategy for the food delivery platform, ensuring competitive advantages in both domestic and international markets. Analyze industry trends, user demands, technological innovations, and global competition to provide strategic recommendations and support executive decisions.

2. Collaborate with global teams to optimize operations, improve order conversion rates, and enhance customer retention across international markets. Tailor strategies based on regional user needs and local market characteristics.

3. Analyze international market behavior and demand shifts, and implement product and service innovations to increase global market share and customer satisfaction.

4. Conduct regular industry analysis, track competitive landscapes, market dynamics, and technological developments, and continuously update the global strategic plan. Establish and monitor KPIs to assess strategy execution.

5. Build and maintain strategic partnerships with global stakeholders including merchants, delivery providers, payment platforms, and logistics partners to strengthen market position and brand presence.

Job Requirements:

1. Bachelor degree(Master/MBA degree is a plus) with experience in strategy planning, business analysis, or consulting in the food delivery, e-commerce, or tech industries. Cross-department collaboration and project management experience is essential.

2. Strong international market insights with the ability to analyze data and identify global opportunities and risks in the food delivery sector.

3. Familiarity with food delivery platform operations, including merchant management, logistics, and payment systems, with the ability to drive optimization and innovation in international markets.

4. Fluent in English with excellent written and verbal communication skills (Speaking Arabic/Portuguese is a Plus), and the ability to collaborate and execute strategies in a global work environment.

5. Proficient in office software, with strong analytical and strategic thinking skills to quickly identify opportunities and risks and make informed decisions.

6. Strong team spirit, execution capabilities, and the ability to thrive in a fast-paced environment, ensuring effective cross-departmental collaboration and strategy implementation.

Job Highlights:

Join us to collaborate with a world-class team, driving innovation and growth for our food delivery platform in global markets, while enjoying extensive career development opportunities. Below are what makes this role even more exciting!

1. Expand Your Horizons with a "Startup Opportunity": Join Keeta's international journey and will have the chance to take the lead in building a team from scratch in new markets. As you help the business grow rapidly, you'll also experience continuous and accelerated personal development.

2. Mentorship from Top Executives: Receive one-on-one coaching from Keeta's senior executives. Participate in important internal project and get close to business decision-making processes.

3. Diverse Rotations & Clear Career Path: Rotate across key business areas (merchants, users, riders) to gain a comprehensive understanding of the food delivery business. Rotate across different markets to understand and adapt to local demands. Rotate through different business stages (stable operation, 0-1 expansion) to become a versatile business expert.

4. Advanced Business Insights: Benefit from Meituan's advanced understanding and scientific methodologies in the food delivery industry. Meituan's deep industry knowledge and organizational capabilities, honed over 10 years of market leadership in China, provide a solid foundation for your growth.

5. Leadership Development: Access customized and systematic leadership training programs to help you become a successful business leader.

title: Information Technology Specialist
description:
Overview

We are looking for a dedicated and proactive On-Site IT Support Engineer to provide hands-on support for our local infrastructure, users, and critical systems. This role ensures smooth IT operations, continuity of services, and timely resolution of incidents during the designated support period. The engineer will serve as the primary point of contact for IT-related issues at the site, while also performing preventive maintenance and ensuring system stability.

Key Responsibilities

Scope of Work / Activities to be Covered

  • Provide on-site support for resolving technical incidents related to infrastructure, systems, and end-user devices.
  • Perform monitoring of IT equipment and infrastructure maintenance, ensuring uptime and reliability.
  • Offer desktop/user support for local staff, including troubleshooting hardware, software, and connectivity issues.
  • Conduct preventive maintenance activities such as security checks, system health checks, and patch updates.
  • Monitor and coordinate critical service requests with remote teams and vendors as needed.
  • Assist in escalating complex incidents to higher-level support teams while ensuring proper follow-through.
  • Expected Results
  • Operational Continuity Maintenance: Ensure that business processes and local operations remain unaffected during the support period.
  • Quality of Service: Deliver efficient, timely, and professional IT support with effective problem-solving skills.
  • Reliable Technical Support: Minimize downtime and interruptions across IT systems and infrastructure.
  • Documentation and Reporting: Prepare and submit clear incident logs, resolution details, and preventive maintenance reports for transparency and accountability.

Qualifications & Skills

  • Should be able to communicate in English
  • Proven experience in IT support, helpdesk, or desktop engineering roles.
  • Strong knowledge of Windows/Mac operating systems, networking basics, hardware, and peripherals.
  • Familiarity with ITSM ticketing systems and incident management processes.
  • Ability to conduct preventive maintenance and security checks.
  • Strong communication skills and ability to interact with end-users at all levels.
  • Detail-oriented with strong documentation and reporting skills.
  • Professional certifications (CompTIA A+, Network+, ITIL, or Microsoft/CCNA) are a plus.

title: Engenheiro De Homologação
description:
Engenheiro de Homologação

A Jetour está comprometida em construir, no mercado brasileiro, uma marca automotiva centrada no cliente e impulsionada por tecnologia.

Estamos em busca de um(a) Engenheiro(a) Sênior de Homologação Regulatória, que atuará como elo estratégico entre produto, tecnologia e as regulamentações locais no Brasil.

Este(a) profissional será responsável por garantir que nossos veículos estejam plenamente em conformidade com as exigências regulatórias brasileiras, além de participar ativamente da definição da estratégia de localização de produtos, contribuindo de forma decisiva para o lançamento bem-sucedido e a competitividade contínua no mercado.

Responsabilidades:

-Gestão de projetos de homologação

-Interface com órgãos e auditorias

-Monitoramento regulatório

Acompanhar e interpretar continuamente as atualizações de leis, normas e políticas no Brasil (como emissões, segurança e eficiência energética), assegurando a comunicação eficaz dessas mudanças para as equipes globais de P&D.

-Suporte técnico e colaboração

Trabalhar em estreita colaboração com equipes globais de engenharia, contribuindo com visão regulatória para adaptação local de produtos, otimização técnica e desenvolvimento.

Requisitos obrigatórios:

  • Graduação completa (ou superior) em Engenharia Mecânica, Engenharia Automotiva, Engenharia Elétrica, Mecatrônica ou áreas correlatas

  • Sólido conhecimento da regulamentação brasileira CONAMA 492/2018 (Proconve L8) e dos processos de certificação veicular junto ao INMETRO, bem como entendimento das tendências futuras do Proconve L8
  • Conhecimento da arquitetura de veículos a combustão e híbridos, incluindo sistemas de powertrain

Diferenciais:

title: Ai Automation Specialist
description:
Hey, Dingus!

Yep, you read that right. Dingus & Zazzy is expanding, and we're on the hunt for a sharp, systems-minded AI Automation Specialist who can build, connect, and scale intelligent workflows that actually work in production.

About Us

Dingus & Zazzy is a global digital marketing agency helping brands grow across every corner of the digital landscape. We offer an "unlimited get-shit-done" subscription for our clients, from websites to social to SEO and everything in between.

Our team is full of creatives, strategists, tech geeks, and builders who love making brands look, feel, and perform better online. If that sounds like your vibe, keep reading.

What You'll Do

  • Build and maintain automated workflows using N8N, connecting APIs, webhooks, and data sources into seamless pipelines.
  • Integrate and prompt Claude (Anthropic) and other LLMs into production systems, not just experiments.
  • Manage and automate data operations in Airtable, including scripted fields, automations, and structured data pipelines.
  • Design AI-assisted workflows that reduce manual effort across client delivery, internal ops, and content production.
  • Troubleshoot broken pipelines, handle edge cases, and document systems so they don't live only in your head.
  • Collaborate with strategy and delivery teams to identify automation opportunities and scope builds accurately.
  • Stay current on the AI tooling landscape, you should know what's worth using before we ask.
  • Own and iterate on AI agent logic and system prompts, understanding why a workflow behaves the way it does and improving it over time.
  • Build net-new internal AI tools as the business identifies opportunities, not just maintain what exists.

What You Bring

  • 2+ years of hands-on experience building automated workflows (N8N, Make.Com, or Zapier, N8N strongly preferred).
  • Real experience integrating LLMs via API (Claude, GPT, or equivalent) into production pipelines with structured outputs.
  • Proficiency in Airtable as a data layer, scripting, automations, relational structures.
  • Solid understanding of REST APIs, JSON, and webhook-based integrations.
  • Basic scripting ability in Python or JavaScript, enough to write and debug function nodes without hand-holding.
  • A working understanding of HTML and CSS is imperative, you need to be able to read, interpret, and make sense of front-end structure when workflows touch web-based outputs.
  • A systems thinker mindset: you design the whole loop, not just the happy path.
  • Ability to work independently in a fully remote, fast-paced environment.
  • Comfort with versioning and testing AI outputs, you notice when a prompt change breaks something and know how to fix it.

Bonus Points

  • Experience with vector databases or basic RAG pipelines (Pinecone, Supabase, etc.).
  • Familiarity with AI agent frameworks (LangChain, or equivalent concepts).
  • Experience in a digital agency or client-services environment.
  • Exposure to prompt engineering best practices, like system prompts, chaining, few-shot design.

Work Details

  • Hours: 9 A.M. – 5 P.M. MST, Monday to Friday
  • Requires a working level of written and spoken English

If you're someone who can look at a messy manual process, see the system hiding inside it, and build something that runs without you, we want to hear from you.

Ready for the ride of your life? Apply now!

title: Senior International Procurement, Transportantion And Logistics Analyst - English 90%
description:
About the job

The Senior Analyst, International Logistics, serves as a key strategic partner within the Raw Materials Procurement organization, responsible for ensuring the efficient, cost‐effective, and resilient movement of raw materials across the global supply chain. This role combines advanced data analytics with deep logistics expertise to design, optimize, and manage international transportation flows that support production, reduce total landed cost, and strengthen supplier and carrier performance. Serving as a boots‐on‐the‐ground contact, the Senior Analyst drives communication, negotiation, and alignment with both suppliers and transportation providers to ensure operational execution, strategic development and continuous improvement. The Senior Analyst maintains accurate inventory positions through accurate reporting of materials in the supply chain, identifies network inefficiencies, and develops improvement initiatives that enhance service, reduce risk, and support long‐term supply chain competitiveness. Through proactive analysis, cross‐functional collaboration, and continuous process optimization, this position ensures that the company's global logistics operations are predictable, transparent, and aligned with broader supply chain and business

Scope. Santa Catarina Brazil

objectives

  • Support the efficient and cost‐effective movement of international raw materials by providing accurate data analysis, shipment visibility, and operational coordination.
  • Act as a connector between procurement, logistics, and supplier/carrier partners by translating operational realities and commercial priorities into clear insights and actions.
  • Identify issues and trends, and recommend opportunities for improvement across the international logistics network to strengthen service performance and reduce total landed cost.

What do you need?

To live in Santa Catarina mandatory English 90%

Educational Background: Bachelor of Science in Supply Chain, Business, or a related field, or

equivalent experience.

- Professional Experience: A minimum of 5 years in transportation, international logistics, or

supply chain analytics, with a proven track record of success.

- Detailed knowledge of the North American transportation industry, including LTL, truckload, rail,

warehousing, cross-border, and airfreight

- Knowledge of standard transportation import and export procedures and USDOT requirements

- Advanced experience with transportation pricing methods and practices, customs entry

processes and brokerage/clearance requirements preferred

- Demonstrated experience negotiating commercial terms for both master transportation

agreements and ad hoc projects with carriers, brokers, customs brokers, and rail lines.

- Fundamental understanding of CHEP global operations and business segments preferred

- Thorough understanding of the CHEP network pallet flows and seasonality preferred

Skills and Knowledge - Business Acumen and Problem Solving: Apply knowledge of business rules and processes to

manage organizational tasks efficiently. Utilize strong time management and problem-solving

skills to address challenges effectively

Key Responsibilities May Include:

  • Build and maintain strong relationships with domestic and international carriers, freight forwarders, and suppliers to support reliable and cost‐effective logistics operations.
  • Recommend optimal Incoterms and transportation strategies by assessing risk, cost, and supplier capabilities.
  • Monitor international shipments to maintain accurate daily visibility, escalating delays and risks and supporting timely resolution with carriers, suppliers, and internal teams.
  • Analyze logistics and inventory flow data to identify variances, inefficiencies, and potential cost‐saving or performance‐enhancing opportunities.
  • Prepare regular reporting and dashboards covering shipment status, carrier performance, costs, and inventory impacts to support decision‐making across procurement and operations.
  • Support contract and carrier management activities by gathering performance data, documenting service issues, and contributing to review discussions.
  • Maintain routing guidelines, documentation, and SOPs, helping ensure consistency and accuracy in transportation execution and compliance.
  • Assist with root‐cause investigations into service failures or cost issues, coordinating inputs across carriers, suppliers, and operational stakeholders.
  • Collaborate with planning, sourcing, operations, and transportation teams to ensure alignment on inbound flows, priorities, and risk areas.

title: Senior Data Engineer
description:
We are seeking a full-time, remote Senior Data Engineer with 5+ years of experience to join our U.S. client's software engineering team. This key individual should have experience making decisions, working on a small development team, and working both independently and as part of a small, dynamic team where everything you do makes a difference.

The industry-leading client provides business-automating, enterprise resource planning (ERP) accounting software for the oil & gas industry. The client's software and services streamline and automate complex processes, such as revenue distribution, billing, order management, production accounting, accounts payable, contract management, and more, for over 1,700 customers across 9 countries.

The senior-level position will be part of the client's Intelligence team. This business intelligence solution brings data from multiple products onto one platform, enabling analysis and data-driven insights. Responsibilities will focus on designing, building, and maintaining scalable data pipelines and infrastructure that converts raw data into a format ready for ingestion by a BI tool. The individual will coordinate with the implementation team to provide on-time deliverables, quality products, and exceptional customer service.

Responsibilities

  • Build and maintain scalable data pipelines that power clients' products, which support core product functionality, customer reporting, and internal analytics.
  • Take end‐to‐end ownership of data flows, from ingestion to delivery, with a focus on data quality and reliability.
  • Create and maintain production‐grade database views and transformation logic.
  • Develop, optimize, and manage SQL view scripts and transformations.
  • Design, configure, and maintain database architectures, distributed systems, and data storage solutions.
  • Ensure data integrity by implementing validation processes for data accuracy, consistency, and reliability.
  • Monitor system performance, troubleshoot issues, and optimize data queries and workflows for efficiency.
  • Build and support data integrations with internal services and third‐party APIs, managing authentication, schema evolution, rate limits, and error handling. Proactively adapt pipelines as client products and customer needs grow.
  • Research and recommend innovative approaches for project execution. Recommend areas for improvement in internal processes along with possible solutions, providing status reports to stakeholders, and addressing issues as appropriate.
  • Participate with the team in problem resolution regarding systems and procedures. Assists the team or supervisor in identifying data anomalies and providing business solutions.
  • Document procedures using text, workflow diagrams, and screenshots from the application. Develops and maintains installations and configuration procedures. Provides documentation for institutional workflow processes associated with the application.

Required Experience

  • Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, Finance, Accounting, or related field
  • Excellent English verbal and written communication skills
  • 5+ years of data engineering experience
  • 3+ years SQL and Python experience
  • Knowledge of database architecture and management
  • Experience working with Cloud Platforms (Azure, AWS, GCP, etc.)
  • Ability to read code and convert programming logic from one language to another
  • Familiarity with APIs

Preferred Experience

  • Experience working with data analytics tools (e.G., Power BI, QuickSight, Looker, Sisense)
  • Experience with Apache Airflow
  • Experience with AI coding tools and/or AI assistants
  • Background in Math, Stats, Machine Learning

Additional Information

  • Knowing your ideas are heard and matter, think big!
  • You get to own your job and be recognized for your contributions
  • Work with smart and creative people
  • Making mistakes is human. Let's learn from them. Be transparent!
  • We recognize you as an individual, with no presumptions or judgment. Be the extraordinary you!
  • 15 days Paid Time Off (PTO), 1 floating day, 3 sick days, and designated national holidays
  • Start: ASAP

About Velozient

We are a privately held, nearshore software development company providing outsourced development resources to North American companies. Our mission is to offer development talent who enjoy taking on challenging work, want to grow their skills and experiences building software, and excel in a fast-paced, dynamic team environment. We are focused on providing world-class remote resources to work as valued client team members. If this type of opportunity excites you, then consider joining our team!

title: Operations Quality & Performance Expert
description:
Let's talk about Keeta

Keeta is the international arm of Meituan, one of the world's largest delivery platforms. Our mission is bold: to revolutionize the delivery of food and everyday products across the globe. Our motto says it all: "We help people eat better, live better."

With our Brazil launch approaching, we are expanding quickly and building a world-class team from the ground up. If you thrive in fast-paced environments, enjoy solving complex operational challenges, and want to make a visible impact, this could be the right opportunity for you.

About the Role

We are looking for a detail-oriented and analytical Operations Quality & Performance Expert to drive operational excellence through data, quality control, and performance tracking.

In this role, you will monitor key processes, ensure compliance with standards, and identify opportunities to improve execution quality. You will work closely with cross-functional teams to translate data insights into actionable improvements and support the achievement of business targets.

What You'll Do

  • Monitor adherence to SOPs, SLAs, and quality standards across operations
  • Track and analyze key performance indicators (KPIs), ensuring accuracy and consistency of data
  • Evaluate operational performance against business goals and identify gaps or deviations
  • Conduct root cause analysis on performance or compliance issues and structure actionable insights
  • Drive and follow up on improvement initiatives to enhance quality and operational efficiency
  • Build and deliver regular reports on performance, compliance, and target achievement
  • Partner with stakeholders to ensure alignment on processes, metrics, and execution priorities

What We're Looking For

  • Bachelor's degree or equivalent experience
  • Experience in operations, performance management, quality, compliance, or data analysis
  • Strong analytical skills with the ability to translate data into insights and actions
  • Experience with KPI tracking, dashboards, and reporting (with tools like Excel, SQL, or BI platforms)
  • High attention to detail and a structured, problem-solving mindset
  • Ability to manage tasks independently and follow through with execution
  • Strong communication and stakeholder management skills

Why Join Us

  • Be part of building and scaling a new global delivery platform from the ground up
  • Work in a dynamic environment where analytical insights directly influence operational performance
  • Collaborate with talented teams across product, engineering, and operations
  • Join a culture that values ownership, innovation, and continuous learning

Ready to jump in?

Apply directly here on LinkedIn and upload your updated resume in English. Our Talent Team will contact qualified candidates.

You can also explore our other open roles on Keeta's LinkedIn page. By applying, your information will be stored securely and may be shared with Keeta and its affiliated companies worldwide.

We look forward to connecting with you.

#Keeta #EatBetterLiveBetter

title: Ehs Supervisor
description:
About Envision

Envision is a global green technology group committed to accelerating the energy transition through integrated renewable, storage, digital and hydrogen solutions.

Envision provides renewable energy system solutions to corporations, governments, and institutions worldwide, reducing the cost of renewable energy production, storage, and integration through continuous technological innovation. The company's business spans smart wind turbines, energy storage, and green hydrogen solutions.

Today, Envision operates as an integrated net-zero technology ecosystem, combining hardware, software, and system integration capabilities across the full energy value chain.

The Group maintains a strong international presence with:

20+ R&D and operations centers

50+ manufacturing bases

80+ GW of installed wind capacity globally

10+ GWh of delivered storage capacity

Expanding green hydrogen industrial platforms

Over 50% of the international workforce

Key Platforms

Smart Wind Turbines

Envision's smart wind platform integrates advanced sensing, digital models and digital twin technologies via the Galileo SuperSense System. With 80+ GW installed globally, Envision ranks first globally in orders and second in new installations since 2022, maintaining a leading international market position.

Energy Storage

The energy storage platform provides full-stack capabilities across battery cells, BMS, PCS, EMS and SCADA, delivering integrated end-to-end solutions. The business ranks third in China and fourth globally, with 200+ projects and 15+ GWh in orders. The ecosystem includes Envision AESC (global battery leader) and Univers (AIoT-enabled digital energy management platform).

Green Hydrogen

Envision is developing large-scale integrated green hydrogen and ammonia industrial parks, including one of the world's largest net-zero hydrogen projects in Chifeng, Inner Mongolia (1.5 million tons planned annual capacity).

Key Responsibilities

  • Supervise daily EHS activities on-site, ensuring compliance with safety standards and procedures
  • Conduct risk assessments and ensure proper control measures for high-risk activities (e.G., work at height, lifting operations, electrical works)
  • Monitor contractor activities and enforce EHS requirements
  • Perform regular site inspections and safety audits
  • Lead incident reporting and support investigations, ensuring corrective actions are implemented
  • Promote safety awareness through toolbox talks and on-site training
  • Ensure compliance with local regulations and company EHS policies
  • Support emergency preparedness, including drills and response coordination

Job Requirements

  • Bachelor's degree or technical qualification in Occupational Health & Safety, Engineering, or related fields
  • Experience in EHS within wind farm, construction, or energy projects is preferred
  • Strong knowledge of high-risk activities (lifting, working at heights, electrical safety)
  • Familiarity with local EHS regulations and standards
  • Experience supervising contractors on-site
  • Advanced English (to be tested)
  • Availability to work on-site and travel as required

title: Engenheiro De Testes E Calibração
description:
SOBRE A VAGA:

Buscamos um(a) Engenheiro de Testes e Calibração para garantir alta disponibilidade, confiabilidade e performance dos equipamentos de teste, atuando de forma estratégica na gestão, calibração e manutenção de toda a cadeia de medição — incluindo sensores, cabos, condicionamento de sinal e sistemas de aquisição de dados (DAQ).

Esta posição é referência técnica na área, apoiando engenheiros e técnicos na seleção, configuração e uso correto da instrumentação, além de liderar iniciativas de melhoria contínua e evolução tecnológica do parque de testes.

FORMAÇÃO

Formação superior completa em Engenharia Mecânica, Mecatrônica, Elétrica/Eletrônica ou áreas correlatas.

RESPONSABILIDADES

  • Gerir o ciclo de vida dos equipamentos de teste e instrumentação, incluindo inventário, criticidade, padrões, documentação e rastreabilidade.
  • Planejar e executar calibração e manutenção preventiva/corretiva, assegurando conformidade metrológica e máxima disponibilidade dos sistemas.
  • Realizar diagnóstico de falhas e troubleshooting em sensores, cabos, conectores, DAQ e condicionamento de sinal, garantindo qualidade e repetibilidade das medições.
  • Configurar e comissionar sistemas de aquisição de dados conforme demanda dos testes, com suporte a setups em bancada e em veículo.
  • Definir e manter procedimentos, instruções e padrões de instrumentação, incluindo boas práticas de medição, montagem, inspeção e armazenamento.
  • Treinar e suportar engenheiros e técnicos, promovendo o uso eficiente e correto dos sistemas de medição.
  • Conduzir análises de obsolescência e necessidades futuras, elaborando roadmaps e apoiando solicitações de investimento para atualização e expansão do parque de testes.
  • Atuar como interface técnica com fornecedores e sites globais, alinhando tecnologias, métodos e requisitos locais.

REQUISITOS

  • Inglês avançado (leitura, escrita e conversação) para interação com times globais e fornecedores.
  • Experiência prática com equipamentos de teste e instrumentação, incluindo sensores (temperatura, pressão, aceleração, strain gages, entre outros).
  • Conhecimento sólido em metrologia e rotina de calibração (rastreabilidade, certificados, tolerâncias e gestão de intervalos).
  • Vivência com sistemas de aquisição de dados (DAQ), incluindo configuração e troubleshooting (cabeamento, conectores, ruído, aterramento e integridade de sinal).
  • Perfil organizado, com capacidade de planejamento, priorização e gestão de documentação.
  • Boa comunicação, postura de atendimento ao cliente interno e colaboração com engenheiros e técnicos.

DIFERENCIAIS:

  • Experiência com ferramentas/fornecedores de DAQ como Dewesoft ou IPETRONIK.
  • Familiaridade com barramentos e protocolos veiculares (CAN, Ethernet, LIN).

CARGO

Analista de Testes e Calibração

CONTRATAÇÃO E BENEFÍCIOS

  • Contrato CLT;
  • Refeição no local;
  • Plano de saúde;
  • Seguro de vida;
  • Horário: 2a a 6a das 08:00 às 17:15 (100% presencial);
  • Local: Curitiba-PR.

title: Analista De Fp&A Pleno
description:
Olá! Aqui é a NotCo.

Somos um grupo de pessoas unidas por um propósito muito forte.

Queremos que você nos conheça, a nós e ao Giuseppe, nossa própria inteligência artificial.

Somos amantes de boa comida, mas acima de tudo, amamos o planeta. Assim, para protegê-lo, reinventamos a indústria alimentícia, uma deliciosa mordida de cada vez, elevando o que comemos por meio de nossa tecnologia à base de plantas.

Nossa receita? Ela inclui três componentes principais: ciência, tecnologia e, claro, talentos disruptivos. Trabalhamos diariamente para criar um futuro melhor.

Na NotCo, não estamos buscando ser a empresa perfeita, mas sim a certa. Estamos aqui para provocar mudanças, é por isso que ousamos, falhamos e, às vezes, alcançamos sucessos incríveis.

Para nossa operação no Brasil, buscamos a função de Analista de FP&A Pleno, cuja principal missão será apoiar o planejamento financeiro e a análise de desempenho da companhia, contribuindo para a tomada de decisões estratégicas e sustentando o crescimento do negócio.

Responsabilidades:

  • Apuração e validação do fechamento mensal das despesas de OpEx e P&L;
  • Finance partnerdas áreas funcionais por meio de atualização das conciliações do fechamento mensal e atualização das projeções das despesas;
  • Construção e consolidação do Forecast e Budget do P&L;
  • Ponto de contato da área de tesouraria para envio atualizado da projeção do P&L;
  • Atualização do reporte financeiro regional com a performance financeira mensal;
  • Suporte para apresentações locais e regionais;
  • Suporte a funcionário de RGM com contabilizações e fechamento mensal.

Requisitos da Vaga:

  • Formação em economia, administração, engenharia, contabilidade ou áreas correlatas;
  • Pacote Office intermediário (Word, Excel, Power Point);
  • Desejável familiaridade com SAP;
  • Organização, atenção a detalhes e senso de prioridade.

A pergunta de um milhão de dólares: Você está faminto para mudar o mundo? Porque há muitas razões para tomar a decisão e dizer: WHY NOT!

Hoje, você pode começar a fazer uma mudança pelo planeta sem mudar tudo o que você ama.

About The Methodical Group

The Methodical Group (methodicalgroup.Com) is a leading global provider of IT Services, Consulting, and Specialized Staffing Solutions, operating with a systematic, high-quality approach for over 25 years. Headquartered in St. Petersburg, Florida, we use proprietary frameworks, such as ExactTalent, to provide specialized workforce solutions, including permanent placement and contract staffing, across industries such as IT and Healthcare. Simultaneously, our IT and Business Services division offers expert solutions in Software Development, Data & Analytics, and IT Operations, aiming to help organizations worldwide drive digital transformation, improve efficiency, and maintain a competitive edge.

About the Opportunity

Our client is seeking an Implementation Analyst to support their Professional Services team, leading end-to-end deployments of a SaaS platform across municipal government clients. This role combines project leadership, client engagement, and product expertise—guiding customers through configuration, setup, data migration, and training to ensure successful system adoption.

The Implementation Analyst will work closely with clients to understand business requirements and translate them into scalable system solutions, ensuring each customer realizes measurable value while delivering a seamless and high-quality onboarding experience.

Responsibilities

  • Lead the full implementation lifecycle for new customers, from kickoff through go-live, managing multiple concurrent implementations for small-to-mid-sized municipal clients.
  • Conduct discovery sessions to gather business requirements, workflows, and success metrics, translating them into system configurations.
  • Configure and customize the SaaS platform based on client-specific use cases while maintaining best practices and scalability.
  • Coordinate with Data Engineers on data imports and integrations, performing QA testing to validate functionality and data integrity prior to go-live.
  • Deliver customer training sessions to ensure user adoption and proficiency across departments.
  • Monitor project timelines, proactively managing scope, risks, dependencies, and overall project health.
  • Document configurations, implementation decisions, and knowledge base materials to support consistency and scalability.
  • Collaborate with Product, Support, and Customer Success teams to ensure smooth transition and ongoing client success post-launch.
  • Identify opportunities for process improvement and recommend best practices to optimize future implementations.

Qualifications

  • At least 2 years of Professional Services or Implementation experience supporting Enterprise SaaS products.
  • Bachelor's degree or equivalent practical experience.
  • Strong understanding of SaaS platforms, cloud environments, and data management principles.
  • Working knowledge of data concepts such as file formats, field mapping, and data validation, with the ability to coordinate effectively with technical teams.
  • Experience using tools such as Wrike, HubSpot, Salesforce, Jira, or similar implementation and project tracking platforms.
  • Proven experience working directly with clients and managing multiple implementation projects simultaneously.
  • Ability to manage client relationships professionally, set expectations, and communicate effectively throughout the project lifecycle.
  • Strong ability to translate technical concepts into clear, business-friendly language.
  • Excellent problem-solving, analytical, communication, organizational, and time-management skills.
  • Ability to quickly learn new technologies, tools, and business domains.

title: Area Sales Manager (Santa Catarina State)
description:
Ecorobotix SA. creates innovative robotic solutions that reduce the negative ecological impact of modern agriculture. We have developed an AI-based ultra-high precision spot spraying technology that drastically reduces the amount of chemicals used in crop fields while keeping costs competitive. The technology is currently deployed on our tractor towed ARA machine. By joining our talented and dynamic team, you will contribute to a more sustainable, environment-friendly agriculture in an innovative scale-up at the cutting edge of technology. We are a revolutionary organization with a great work environment that supports creativity through self-motivation.

To pursue our growth in Brazil, we are hiring an experienced entrepreneurial mind based in Santa Catarina State for an:

Area Sales Manager

General objective of the role

As an Area Sales Manager of the Ecorobotix SA. Team, you will be responsible for managing and expanding the sales of agricultural machinery within a designated region. The role involves overseeing existing dealer relationships, optimizing dealer performance, and driving new business opportunities by identifying future dealers and customers as well as driving revenue growth. The Area Sales Manager will work closely with dealers to ensure product availability, support, and training, ensuring the company's agricultural machinery is effectively marketed and sold. This position requires a leader with a deep understanding of market dynamics, strong leadership skills, and the ability to foster a results-oriented sales culture within the region.

Reporting lines and interactions

This role reports directly to the Commercial Director. Internally, you will closely collaborate with other members of the Sales team and other teams of Ecorobotix. Externally, you will interact with dealers, farmers, partners, associations, trade shows, Agronomists, and CCA's.

A day in the life of an Area Sales Manager

The Area Sales Manager will travel across the designated territory to visit key accounts, meet new prospects, and support dealer partners. Whether you're pulling into a grower's yard or a dealership lot, you're the face of a cutting-edge ag-tech company that's reshaping the future of precision spraying.

You will showcase how our high-precision sprayer delivers real ROI: less chemical waste, more targeted application, and better yields. You walk growers through the technology— highlighting features like variable rate spraying and intelligent targeting—while grounding every conversation in real-world impact. You sit down and dig into the potential customer's specific challenges and help them see how the product fits into their operation. You're not just selling equipment;
you're helping solve problems.

"You're part field representative, part storyteller, part strategist. You're a trusted advisor selling value, not just hardware."

Key Responsibilities

  • Identify and prospect new customers across Brazil, managing all communication and driving the sales process through to contract signature.
  • Engage with customers to understand their needs and provide tailored solutions, ensuring strong order generation and relationship development.
  • Assess customer solvency, share pricing information, negotiate terms, and suggest improvements to optimize pricing strategies.
  • Provide training and ongoing support to partners, while identifying opportunities for expanding and strengthening the partner network.
  • Actively participate in industry fairs, customer demos, and events to increase visibility and drive engagement in the region.
  • Foster collaboration and support within the distributor network to drive sales and enhance product reach.
  • Create compelling content in collaboration with the marketing team to support campaigns and enhance brand presence.

Qualifications

  • Master's degree in Sales and/or Agronomy, or related field.
  • 10+ years of experience in sales and hands-on experience in agriculture, ag-tech, or precision equipment.
  • Willingness to travel domestically in Brazil.

Must-Have

  • Experience in Ag-tech or chemical distribution.
  • Knowledge in Agronomy related to weeding in field crops.

Your Assets

  • Excellent communication and leadership skills, willingness to build relationships with customers.
  • Exceptional written and verbal presentation skills, with clear & consistent communication.
  • High degree of independence, reliability, and spirit of initiative.
  • Driven individual with systematic, goal-oriented working methods.
  • Computer skills. Proficiency in Microsoft Word, Excel, PowerPoint, and CRM tools.
  • Strong organizational and multi-tasking skills
  • Team-player

title: Technical Support Analyst
description:
The Position:

The Technical Support Specialist position is based in Osasco and plays an important role in this rapidly growing company. This is a dynamic and fast-paced role reporting to the Operations Service Manager. The position will be a key member of the service team and will serve as the primary point of contact for customers and partners with commercial, industrial, and utility-scale solar and battery plants.

Essential Duties and Responsibilities:

  • Answer customer calls and provide technical and customer support.
  • Communicate with customers via phone and email to deliver quick issue resolution, with the goal of achieving "one-call resolution."
  • Demonstrate exceptional listening skills and strong customer service in all written and verbal interactions.
  • Create cases in the CRM system, take ownership of them, and communicate professionally with customers via portal, email, WhatsApp, and phone on a daily basis until resolution or escalation.
  • Continuously document work throughout the day and provide detailed ticket updates.
  • Escalate tickets to the Service Manager or Project Manager, providing clear background information to ensure fast resolution.
  • Handle customer questions, complaints, and technical support inquiries with a high level of professionalism and courtesy.
  • Create and approve RMAs, coordinating shipment of units or replacement parts in a timely manner with logistics partners or internal teams.
  • Track RMAs and spare parts in the system to ensure delivery to the field within 24 to 48 hours.
  • Support the creation of internal repair procedures for inverters.
  • Prepare first-level failure reports for customers related to RMAs.
  • Maintain failure rate reports in the system based on RMA data.
  • Assist in scheduling shipments and coordinating third-party field support when needed.
  • Perform a wide variety of additional tasks and special projects as assigned.
  • Coordinate with the R&D team for scheduling and resolving critical cases.
  • Manage warranty repairs and component replacements.
  • Determine whether issues are internal or external and whether they are covered under warranty.

Minimum Requirements:

  • Previous experience in customer support, preferably with PV products.
  • Ability to work with test equipment and hand tools as required.
  • Strong customer service, problem-solving, decision-making, and analytical skills.
  • Effective written and verbal communication skills.
  • Proficiency in Microsoft Office Suite (Word, Excel, PowerPoint, and Outlook).

Education or Desired License and Certificates:

  • Technical degree in Electrical, Electronics, or Mechatronics, or equivalent experience.
  • Intermediate English level or above.
  • Intermediate Spanish level or above.
  • Solar industry experience is a plus.

Competencies

  • Strong technical problem-solving and analytical skills.

  • Highly organized, detail-oriented, and proactive.
  • Strong focus on technical support and a service-oriented mindset.

Osasco/SP – Full time

  • Compensation commensurate with experience.
  • Competitive benefits package.

Azure Storage – Fundamentos e arquitetura

- Arquitetura de contas do Azure Storage e considerações de design

- Serviços de armazenamento: Blob Storage, Azure Files, Azure Disks, Queue Storage e Table Storage

- Planejamento de capacidade, escalabilidade e otimização de custos

Azure Files

- Alta disponibilidade, snapshots e integração com backup

Azure Networking – Conceitos principais

- Virtual Networks (VNets), sub-redes e endereçamento IP

- Segurança de rede com NSGs e Azure Firewall

- Padrões de conectividade: VPN Gateway, ExpressRoute

- Private Endpoints e service endpoints

- Conceitos de DNS e resolução de nomes no Azure

Monitoramento, observabilidade e operações

- Monitoramento de componentes de Azure Storage, Azure Files e Azure Networking

- Integração com Azure Monitor e Azure Network Watcher

- Métricas de taxa de transferência, latência, disponibilidade e erros

- Monitoramento de contas de armazenamento, compartilhamentos de arquivos e recursos de rede

Logs e análises

- Integração com Log Analytics Workspace

- Análise de logs e métricas usando Kusto Query Language (KQL)

- Criação de Workbooks e dashboards para visibilidade da infraestrutura

- Monitoramento proativo e insights operacionais

Backup, recuperação e resiliência

Proteção de dados e continuidade de negócios

- Conceitos de backup e recuperação para Azure Storage e Azure Files

- Integração com Azure Backup e Recovery Services Vault

- Estratégias de snapshot e validação de restauração

- Requisitos de retenção de dados e conformidade

Alta disponibilidade e recuperação de desastres

- Redundância de armazenamento e arquiteturas com consciência de zona (zone-aware)

- Resiliência de rede e redundância de conectividade

- Cenários de DR entre regiões (cross-region) e híbridos

- Monitoramento de desempenho, capacidade e saúde

Segurança, governança e conformidade

- Criptografia em repouso e em trânsito

- Identidade, controle de acesso e desenho de RBAC

- Governança com Azure Policy e estratégias de tags

- Proteção contra exfiltração de dados e configurações incorretas

Automação e integração (desejável):

- Automação usando PowerShell, Azure CLI ou ARM/Bicep

- Integração com Azure Automation e Logic Apps

- Práticas de Infraestrutura como Código (IaC)

- Runbooks operacionais padronizados

title: Engenheiro(A) De Integração De Software Veicular
description:
SOBRE A VAGA:

ATIVIDADE: Implementação, integração e troubleshooting de software embarcado veicular, com atuação direta em caminhões e sistemas eletroeletrônicos automotivos.

RESUMO

O profissional selecionado atuará no time de Engenharia de Implementação de Software Veicular, em um ambiente industrial e altamente técnico, com foco na integração, validação e diagnóstico de software embarcado em caminhões.

A posição envolve atuação hands-on diretamente nos veículos, garantindo a correta implementação de software, análise de falhas, troubleshooting avançado e conformidade eletroeletrônica para liberação dos caminhões para rodagem.

O trabalho acontece em um contexto global e multifuncional, com interação constante com times de desenvolvimento de software, hardware e engenharia internacional, seguindo metodologia Agile / SCRUM.

FORMAÇÃO

  • Formação superior completa em Engenharia Elétrica, Eletrônica, Mecatrônica, Automação ou áreas correlatas.

AMBIENTE DE TRABALHO

  • Engenharia de Produto / Implementação de Software
  • Atuação presencial em planta industrial
  • Projetos automotivos com interação global

RESPONSABILIDADES

  • Realizar implementação e download de software embarcado em caminhões;
  • Atuar diretamente nos veículos realizando software breakdown, checks elétricos e eletrônicos e troubleshooting;
  • Conduzir análises de causa raiz (root cause analysis) e resolução de problemas complexos;
  • Coletar, analisar e interpretar logs, DTCs, parâmetros e baselines de software;
  • Analisar diagramas elétricos automotivos e arquitetura eletroeletrônica dos veículos;
  • Trabalhar com diferentes arquiteturas e classes de caminhões;
  • Interface contínua com equipes de desenvolvimento de software e hardware, garantindo a conformidade do veículo;
  • Planejar e registrar atividades técnicas (relatórios, JIRA, documentação técnica);
  • Apoiar a preparação dos veículos para testes e liberação para rodagem em via pública.

REQUISITOS

  • Experiência prática com software embarcado automotivo;
  • Vivência com implementação, integração ou validação de software veicular (não P&D);
  • Conhecimento emarquitetura elétrica e eletrônica automotiva (ECUs, redes veiculares);
  • Capacidade de leitura e interpretação de diagramas elétricos automotivos;
  • Conhecimento deprotocolos automotivos: CAN, CAN FD, LIN e Ethernet;
  • Experiência comtroubleshooting e diagnóstico em veículos ou sistemas automotivos;
  • Perfil hands-on, analítico e orientado à resolução de problemas;
  • Conhecimento emmetodologia Agile / SCRUM (JIRA como diferencial);
  • Pacote Office intermediário;
  • Inglês avançadopara comunicação com times globais;
  • CNH C ou D (CNHE é diferencial).

DIFERENCIAIS

  • Experiência prévia em ambiente automotivo pesado (caminhões, ônibus, máquinas);
  • Conhecimento emferramentas de diagnóstico e gestão de software automotivo, como:
  • CANalyzer (Vector);
  • EDB, SW Configurator;
  • Tech Tool / GDSP;
  • Vivência em ambientes industriais e projetos globais;
  • Capacidade de atuar como referência técnica em troubleshooting.

IDIOMAS

  • Inglês avançado – mandatório.

PERFIL

  • Profissional com forte atuação prática e presença em campo;
  • Capaz de trabalhar de forma colaborativa com equipes nacionais e internacionais;
  • Confortável comambiente industrial, pressão técnica e resolução de problemas complexos;
  • Boa comunicação, organização e autonomia para lidar com múltiplas demandas.

CARGO

Analista de Implementação de Software Veicular

CONTRATAÇÃO E BENEFÍCIOS

  • Refeição no local;
  • Plano de saúde;
  • Seguro de vida;

title: Clinical Application Specialist
description:
A pioneer in its field, Echosens significantly changed the practice of liver diagnosis with FibroScan, the non-invasive gold standard solution for comprehensive management of liver health.

FibroScan is recognized worldwide as the reference for liver fibrosis and liver steatosis assessment with more than 5 380+ peer-reviewed publications and 210+ international guidelines.

Echosens has made FibroScan available in over 127 countries through its network of subsidiaries in Europe (Germany, Spain, UK, Italy), the United States and China (Shanghai, Shenzen and Hong Kong), enabling millions of liver examinations worldwide.

Echosens is shaping the future of liver health. As a high-tech company, its connected solutions and services empower medical professionals to manage liver health for simpler, faster and better patient care.

In today's digital healthcare environment and the silent epidemic of fatty liver disease (MASLD-MASH), Echosens is pursuing its international expansion and aims to make the liver check-up part of the health routine for at-risk patients, particularly people living with diabetes.

Joining Echosens means choosing a rich and rewarding career path within an inclusive and dynamic company in a rapidly changing sector: liver health.

To support its strong growth, Echosens is recruiting a:

CLINICAL APPLICATION SPECIALIST (M/W)

LATAM (ideally Mexico or Brazil)

The overall objective is to drive the successful adoption of Echosens technologies across Latin America by supporting healthcare professionals through clinical training, implementation, and ongoing education.

This role plays a key part in empowering medical teams to integrate innovative liver health solutions into their clinical practices and deliver better outcomes for patients.

Main activities:

  • Support the implementation and clinical adoption of Echosens FibroScan technology in healthcare institutions across LATAM
  • Deliver clinical training and education to healthcare professionals and distributor teams
  • Provide clinical and technical support to ensure optimal use of technology
  • Support the sales team with product demonstration, key account training, and clinical expertise

Experience / Education / Special Requirements

You have a bachelor's degree in Life Sciences, Healthcare, Biomedical Engineering, or a related field, and equivalent clinical or technical experience will also be considered. You bring proven experience in implementing and supporting clinical applications within healthcare environments, with a strong understanding of healthcare workflows, processes, and systems.

You have excellent problem-solving and troubleshooting skills, with the ability to deliver effective training and provide user support. Knowledge of healthcare regulations and compliance standards, as well as ultrasound expertise, would be an additional asset.

Fluent in Spanish, Portuguese and English, you are comfortable communicating across diverse teams and healthcare settings. You thrive in collaborative, cross-functional environments and are experienced in coordinating training programs, clinical implementation processes, and other operational methodologies.

You are results-driven, proactive, and self-sufficient, able to identify opportunities, gain consensus, and execute solutions efficiently. Your integrity, trustworthiness, and commitment to diversity of thought, combined with strong relationship-building and communication skills, enable you to excel in international healthcare environments.

Please submit your application and CV in English.

Why join ECHOSENS ?

  • Work on high-impact projects, serving the health of patients around the world.
  • Join a growing, innovative company, where your ideas will be valued and where you can make a difference.
  • Benefit from a collaborative and stimulating work environment, with opportunities for professional development.
  • Contribute to cutting-edge products, within a team passionate about innovation.
  • Adhere to our inclusion, equality and diversity program set up to support our employees in their efforts to be recognized as workers with disabilities.

ECHOSENS is an equal opportunity company in an environment of diversity and does not discriminate in recruiting, hiring, training, promotion or other employment practices because of race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, national origin, age, marital status, health or disability, or any other status protected by law.

title: Ai-First Frontend Engineer (Next.Js & React) - Remote
description:
About LumiMeds

LumiMeds is a fast-growing U.S.-based telehealth startup focused on weight management and long-term metabolic health. We are building the next generation of e-commerce and clinical infrastructure from the ground up.

As an early-stage company, we move quickly, operate with limited layers, and expect high ownership from every team member. There is no bureaucracy here — decisions happen fast, priorities evolve, and builders thrive.

We are a remote-first, globally distributed team that values clarity, accountability, and people who take initiative rather than wait for direction.

Location: Remote / Hybrid - we accept candidates located across LATAM, South America, Europe

Seniority: Mid-Level / Senior (Individual Contributor)

Role Overview

LumiMeds is a high-growth telehealth platform building the next generation of virtual telehealth infrastructure. We are looking for an AI-First Frontend Engineer who builds beautiful, performant, and clinically reliable interfaces —and uses AI to do it at a pace that consistently surprises people.

You are not a designer who codes, nor a utility developer who ships components on request. You are an engineer who can translate a Figma frame into a pixel-perfect, highly performant Next.Js experience, architect the state model behind it, and use AI tooling to compress a week of work into a day. You know how to direct Claude agent teams to handle parallelizable work — generating component variants, writing test suites, auditing accessibility — so you can stay focused on the decisions that require human judgment. You will balance 90% hands-on codingwith 10% mentorship, and you are expected to set the bar for frontend quality and velocity on the team.

Core Technical Domains

You will own the user-facing layer across our consumer and clinical platforms:

  • Performant Marketing & E-commerce: Engineering lightning-fast, SEO-optimized storefronts and landing pages. You treat Core Web Vitals as a first-class deliverable.
  • Clinical Web Application (EMR & Provider Portal): Building the "Clinical OS" — complex, state-heavy interfaces where data integrity and reliability are non-negotiable.
  • AI-Powered UI Features: Implementing streaming LLM responses, real-time clinical summaries, and conversational interfaces embedded into patient and provider flows.
  • Virtual Care Interfaces: Implementing WebRTC video components, real-time secure messaging, and low-latency async consultation flows.
  • Design System & Motion: Maintaining a component library using Framer Motion to produce purposeful animations that make the platform feel premium and intuitive.

Key Responsibilities

  • AI-Augmented Frontend Development: Use Cursor, Copilot, and LLMs as first-class tools to generate components, write tests, and iterate on UI logic at high velocity. Prompt quality is part of the craft.
  • Claude Agent Team Orchestration: Coordinate Claude agent teams via the Claude Agent SDK to execute parallelizable frontend work — generating component variants, writing test suites, auditing accessibility, and producing design-to-code translations at scale. You know how to structure agent prompts, verify outputs, and integrate agent-generated code into the production codebase reliably.
  • Aesthetic Engineering: Translate high-fidelity Figma designs into pixel-perfect, responsive experiences that hold visual integrity across all device sizes and breakpoints.
  • Performance Ownership: Own Core Web Vitals — optimize LCP, INP, and bundle size. Understand hydration, streaming SSR, and caching strategies at a deep level.
  • AI UI Integration: Build and maintain frontend interfaces that consume LLM outputs — streaming text, structured responses, tool-call results — in ways that feel fluid and reliable to end users.
  • State Architecture: Design resilient client-side state capable of handling real-time clinical data, optimistic updates, and complex form flows across the patient journey.
  • Compliance & Security: Ensure all interfaces meet HIPAA/SOC2 standards, with a focus on secure data handling, audit trails, and PII protection.

Required Hard Skills & Tech Stack

  • Next.Js Mastery: Expert-level knowledge of the App Router, Server Components (RSC), and sophisticated caching/streaming strategies.
  • The "Beautiful Web" Stack: Expert proficiency in Tailwind CSS and Framer Motion for fluid, high-end interfaces.
  • Performance Optimization: Proven track record optimizing bundle sizes, hydration cycles, and Lighthouse scores.
  • State Management: Expertise in TanStack Query (server state) and Zustand (client state).
  • LLM UI Patterns: Experience building streaming response UIs, chat interfaces, or AI-assisted input flows using OpenAI or Anthropic APIs.
  • Claude Agent Teams: Hands-on experience building and directing Claude agent teams using the Claude Agent SDK — from bulk component generation to automated visual regression and test coverage. You can design an agent pipeline, define subagent roles, and validate the output before it lands in production.
  • AI Dev Tooling: Daily active use of Cursor, GitHub Copilot, or equivalent. Strong opinions on how to use AI for component generation, refactoring, and test writing.
  • Browser Fundamentals: Deep understanding of the DOM, rendering pipeline, and HIPAA-compliant data handling in the browser.

Candidate Qualifications

  • 3+ years of professional frontend engineering experience.
  • AI-Native Workflow: You can demonstrate concretely how AI has accelerated your frontend output. Examples or portfolio required.
  • The Dual-Threat Portfolio: Proven experience building both visually polished, high-traffic marketing sites and complex, data-driven SaaS applications.
  • Uncompromising Eye for Detail: You notice when spacing is off by 2px and care enough to fix it. Typography, micro-interactions, and motion are part of your craft.
  • High Agency: Ability to self-direct, operate in ambiguity, and make high-leverage frontend decisions without constant supervision.
  • Communication: Professional proficiency in English for technical documentation and cross-functional collaboration.

Why Join LumiMeds?

  • AI as Infrastructure: We don't bolt AI on — it's embedded in how we build. You'll be encouraged and expected to use every tool available to ship faster and better.
  • Design-Forward Culture: We believe healthcare should be beautiful. You'll have the technical freedom to build a premium brand experience without compromise.
  • Direct Impact: Fast, intuitive, and beautiful interfaces directly affect patient outcomes and provider efficiency.

title: Professor De Francês
description:
Faça parte da comunidade de professores que está transformando o ensino de idiomas no Brasil!

Onde os influencers do Brasil fazem suas aulas particulares!

A Idioma Independente, referência em inovação no ensino de idiomas, está buscando pessoas proativas, com perfil proativo e fluência em um segundo idioma, que querem ter sucesso no âmbito profissional, para se credenciar como professores e fazer parte da nossa comunidade engajada.

Aqui, você não será apenas mais um perfil online: você será parte de uma rede colaborativa com mais de 400 professores e 4.000 alunos que vivenciam nossa metodologia transformadora hoje, além de mais de 1000 professores e 10.000 alunos que já fizeram parte desta história.

Nos últimos 12 meses tivemos mais de 22 mil alunos interessados em fazer aulas conosco. Professores novos têm lotado suas agendas em até 30 dias, quando são comprometidos, se comunicam de forma eficaz e tem agenda no horário da noite disponível.

*Esta não é uma vaga CLT*

O que oferecemos?

  • Capacitação intensiva para melhoria no ensino de aulas de acordo com a nossa metodologia inovadora
  • Acesso exclusivo a uma plataforma com mais de 400 vídeos de treinamento, baseada em uma metodologia que já entregou resultados incríveis, com vídeos totalmente atualizados.
  • Mentorias semanais com especialistas experientes, que já treinaram mais de 1500 profissionais.
  • Plataforma exclusiva para acompanhamento das aulas.
  • Participação no nosso processo de captação de alunos, com possibilidade de ganhos adicionais relevantes, bastando você se interessar.
  • Descontos exclusivos em cursos de idiomas e viagens com a nossa comunidade.
  • Possibilidade de desenvolvimento e mentoria para ser um empreendedor de sucesso (se você quiser).
  • Um banco de aulas com mais de 800 aulas para facilitar o seu processo de construção de aulas.
  • Certificações dos treinamentos feitos dentro da comunidade que garantem que você obterá mais resultados juntos aos seus alunos e que agregam na sua carreira como professor independente.

Como saber se você é a pessoa certa para fazer parte da maior comunidade de professores independentes do Brasil?

Se você tem grandes ambições para impactar a educação no Brasil, acredita que o ensino de idiomas precisa de inovação, quer otimizar sua agenda de aulas e, ainda, gostaria de crescer como empreendedor, este é o lugar certo para você.

Necessário:

  • Maior de 18 anos, fluente em Português e outro idioma.
  • Disponibilidade de ao menos 20 horas semanais para treinamentos, aulas e ações práticas Esta é uma necessidade para obter os maiores retornos que a comunidade pode te proporcionar.
  • Possibilidade de participar em capacitações durante a semana, no turno da manhã ou tarde.
  • Independência para executar atividades, espírito de colaboração e vontade de contribuir para uma comunidade.

O diferencial?

Aqui você é mais que um professor.

Você será parte de uma comunidade de professores no ensino de idiomas, onde o trabalho colaborativo é a base para alcançar resultados de mercado altamente competitivos.

Esta não é uma vaga CLT, mas sim uma oportunidade de empreender e ser dono do seu crescimento com total suporte e estrutura de uma empresa inovadora.

Você cria laços e relações de confiança com pessoas que realmente se esforçam para te ajudar no seu desenvolvimento, devido ao modelo de negócio inovador que proporciona relações colaborativas e efetivas.

Se você tem vontade de fazer diferente e de vivenciar algo novo na sua história profissional, a ii com certeza é o seu lugar.

Faça parte da mudança no ensino de idiomas. Junte-se à Idioma Independente e transforme sua carreira e a vida de milhares de alunos!

O que eu faço?

  • Recebo capacitação para dar a melhor aula experimental da sua vida
  • Recebo capacitação em nossa metodologia, aprendendo como transformar a vida de muitos alunos, entregando resultado para eles/as
  • Recebo treinamentos e capacitações recorrentes com mentores experientes e especializados
  • Organizo e escolho a minha agenda e os horários que gostaria de ter alunos/as
  • Preparo aulas para os meus alunos/as
  • Dou as aulas para os meus alunos/as

Se você quiser ir além, também será possível, basta você se engajar na comunidade e aprender mais sobre todas as áreas do seu negócio.

QUANTO EU RECEBO POR ISSO?

  • Se você for somente professor, se dedicando 40h na semana a aulas, você poderá receber até R$4.000,00 por mês.
  • Se você quiser aprender sobre diferentes áreas e se engajar na comunidade, você pode construir uma renda mensal de até R$6.000,00 por mês em aproximadamente 1 ano.
  • Se você realmente quiser crescer e se desenvolver, se dedicando de forma integral junto da comunidade é possível chegar até R$12.000,00 por mês em 2 anos.

Tudo isso só dependerá de você, se quiser aprender mais sobre as partes comerciais e sobre como se tornar um mentor/a de professores.

Seja diferente, seja independente

• Realizar identificação, diagnóstico e resolução de falhas de rede de forma eficiente e dentro dos prazos estabelecidos.

Experiência com tecnologias SD-WAN, WLAN e Firewall (VPN client-to-site e site-to-site, regras de firewall, NAT, DPI, IPS).

Experiência em troubleshooting, incluindo identificação de falhas de hardware, uso de documentação técnica e ferramentas/plataformas corporativas.

Vivência em ambientes com processos estruturados, seguindo boas práticas de gestão de incidentes.

title: Client Service Analyst Temporary
description:
Welcome to RIMOWA, the first German Maison of the LVMH Group. We are a global lifestyle brand with a mission to create the essential tools for a lifetime of travel. For more than 125 years, we've dedicated ourselves to develop unique products where function coexists with luxury, heritage with innovation, and craftsmanship with design.

At RIMOWA, we believe that great ambitions demand resilient companions. It's why our tools are created with longevity in mind. Because the most meaningful journeys last more than a trip. They last a lifetime.

Please join us to discover your own.

WHAT WE HAVE TO OFFER:

The Client Service Analyst oversees client care by supporting the Sao Paulo client care service team, managing phone calls, e-mails. This professional also deliver an exceptional after-sales experience for our clientele. This position is temporary for 6 months located close to Campo Belo.

YOUR RESPONSIBILITIES:

Customer Service:

  • Omnichannel Customer Service: We are looking for someone capable of providing exceptional service to our customers across various channels - in-person, on the phone, and digital (email, Reclame Aqui platform). You must be agile in problem-solving, proactive in communication, and focused on maximizing customer satisfaction.
  • Focal Point Between Stores and Customer Care: Will act as a liaison between customers in the store and the Customer Care team, ensuring that all issues are communicated effectively and addressed promptly.
  • Online Reputation Management & NPS: The brand image is vital;
    therefore, we expect you to implement innovative strategies to increase our Net Promoter Score (NPS), as well as manage our presence on platforms such as Reclame Aqui, thus strengthening our market reputation.
  • Logistics & Warranty Management: It will be your responsibility to manage the entire process related to exchanges or repairs covered by product warranties - from logistics involvement to effective problem resolution - always focusing on total customer satisfaction. This includes issuing invoices, contact and relationship with the customer, up to the delivery of their suitcase.

Issuance of Invoices:

  • Carry out the issuance of invoices, including stock movement and service invoices.

Preparation of Quotation

  • Create personalized quotation for clients, considering their needs and specifications and provide detailed information about prices, services offered, delivery times, and payment conditions.

Administrative Support

  • Assist in other activities related to customer service and administrative support.

PROFILE:

We want to speak to professionals with at least six months in a production environment, with Customer Service as priority.

Furthermore, we seek:

  • High school diploma (a degree in Business Administration or related fields will be a differential).
  • Previous experience in customer service and/or administrative activities.
  • Basic knowledge of invoice issuance and financial procedures.
  • Ability to handle challenging situations in a professional and courteous manner.
  • Excellent verbal and written communication skills.
  • Ability to work effectively as part of a team and under pressure.
  • English (intermediate level).
  • Availability to work 100% on site close to Campo Belo.

title: .Net Developer
description:

Location: Remote (Brazil-based only)

Salary: $3,500-4,500 per month

Job Type: Contract

  • Strong experience with SQL and relational databases
  • Strong exp with unit testing (to be highlighted in CV)
  • Strong exp with Kubernetes (to be highlighted in CV)
  • Hands-on experience with AWS
  • Experience with Docker
  • Knowledge of CodeQL
  • Experience working with CI/CD tools and workflows
  • Solid understanding of application development principles and best practices
  • Ability to work independently in a remote team environment
  • Excellent problem-solving and communication skills

Nice to Have:

  • Familiarity with Microsoft Entra ID (Azure AD)
  • Exposure to ChatGPT / GPT-4 development or integration of large language models into applications

What We Offer:

  • Fully remote working environment (Brazil-based)
  • Flexible working hours
  • Opportunity to work on modern cloud-native applications

title: Full Stack Engineer
description:
This would be a fully remote position, CLT model and salary range is 16k-22k BRL/mo.

Must-haves

  • 5+ years of experience as a Full-Stack Software Engineer (approximately 70% front end, 30% back end)
  • Strong JavaScript expertise, including ReactJS, Handlebars.Js, and ASP.NET (Visual Studio) for modifying and extending UI components
  • Backend development experience using C#, .NET Core, and Entity Framework, including creating and modifying REST endpoints and extending data models
  • SQL experience across MS SQL, SQLite, and PostgreSQL, including writing queries and stored procedures to extract data

Plusses

  • Experience with C++ development
  • Familiarity with Accessibility standards and related processes

Day-to-Day

You'll work in a swarm model, focusing on one priority product at a time to deliver measurable ADA/WCAG improvements before moving on to the next. The role is front-end heavy (~70%), involving refactoring and enhancing React, Handlebars, and ASP.NET components to meet accessibility standards. The remaining ~30% is back-end focused, extending models and creating or modifying REST endpoints in .NET Core/C# to support updated UI flows. You'll partner closely with Product, UX, and Engineering teams, implement from pre-written accessibility requirements, validate outcomes against the VPAT, and document improvements. Collaboration happens through Teams, daily standups, code reviews, proactive risk and blocker management, and tracking progress toward 2026 goals.

title: Jams Automation Engineer
description:
We are HCLTech, one of the world's largest and fastest growing technology and DSA companies with over 227,000 professionals across 60 countries, driving progress through industry-leading capabilities focused on Digital, Engineering and Cloud.

The driving force behind this work, our people, is a diverse, creative and passionate audience that enables us to continually raise the bar for excellence in our services. This role will be responsible for automating repeatable processes in Sompo's public cloud and on-premise datacenter environments to improve process efficiencies. This role will be responsible for developing, documenting, maintaining, supporting, and optimizing automation workflows. Subject matter expertise is required in Microsoft PowerShell scripting.

ROLE RESPONSIBILITIES

- Develop, test and validate PowerShell scripts as part of automation workflows and maintain in source control for change management.

- Create and Maintain a Dynamic Inventory of all JAMS Scheduler Jobs.

- Create and maintain a JAMS incident tracker for logging dates and times of all warnings and errors from JAMS Scheduler Jobs as well as escalation and fix details.

- Update Job properties (Schedules, Source Code etc.) as directed by Job owners.

- Proactively review and monitor the health of all JAMS Jobs i.E. daily reviewing output of all jobs.

- Review job failures and take corrective action where possible or escalate to Job owner as necessary.

- Log Service Desk ticket (incident) for all JAMS Scheduler Job failures, provide resolution in collaboration with job owner and maintain incident resolution log\ Knowledge base.

- Installation of JAMS Client tools, JAMS software updates and\ Or reporting tools.

- Liaise with JAMS account representative and Sompo procurement in relation to JAMS Scheduler annual support License renewals.

- Participate in IT projects, responsible for development of automation workflows outlined in the Project Plan and directed by the Project Manager, at whatever level of effort or participation has been defined for them.

- Build, administer, monitor and maintain JAMS Enterprise Scheduler and System Center Orchestrator environments.

- Work with Application team members to evaluate automation workflow needs and requirements.

- Develop integrations between infrastructure systems for data analysis and reporting through REST API calls.

- Maintain JAMS platform, standard operating procedures, perform changes, apply patches, and updates as required.

- Prevent, diagnose, troubleshoot, and resolve automation runbook errors.

- Maintain strict change control of the automation infrastructure.

- Continuously identify and report areas of improvement in the automation arena and implement improvements when approved.

- Contribute to on-going research and evaluation of new technologies.

- Responsible for completing other work requirements or tasks that are requested by IT management when necessary to meet the goals and objectives of the department or company.

- Working continuously on a task until completion to ensure business automation workflows remain available 24/7.

- The ability to multitask while ensuring the highest quality of work is maintained.

- Establishing a good working relationship with customers and other IT groups.

- Be able to work independently within established policies and procedures.

- Perform routine tasks unsupervised.

TECHNICAL QUALIFICATIONS

- Excellent technical skills including however not limited to Microsoft Operating systems server including PowerShell scripting, Microsoft SQL Server , Microsoft Azure including Logic Apps, JSON Scripting, REST API.

- Azure or AWS Certification is desirable.

- Experience with System Center Orchestrator 2012 or later preferred.

- Experience with JAMS Enterprise Manager is highly desirable and preferred.

GENERAL QUALIFICATIONS

- Strong background in an Infrastructure environment with a minimum of 5 years' experience.

- Team orientated with the ability to multitask and prioritize workloads.

- Very strong problem solving and analytical skills and is a systemic thinker with an attention to detail.

- Seeks to expand knowledge and experience and is committed to continuous learning.

EDUCATION REQUIREMENTS

- A degree in Information Technology is desirable.

Equality & Opportunity for All

Representing 165 nationalities worldwide, we are proud to be an equal opportunity employer committed to providing equal employment opportunities to all applicants and employees without regard to race, religion, sex, color, age, national origin, pregnancy, sexual orientation, disability or genetic information, or any other protected classification, in accordance with federal, state and/or local laws
